title: What Happens at the Bird Rescue Centre
transcript: At a wildlife rescue centre, I asked keeper Rose Cole what visitors should do if they see a young bird on the ground. 'Watch from a distance first,' she said. 'Its parents may still be feeding it.' I asked when the centre should be called. 'If you can see an injury, call us and describe exactly where the bird is,' she said. Rose told me that once a rescued bird can fly and feed itself, the team usually returns it to the place where it was found.

questions.prompt: What should people do first when they see a young bird on the ground?
options: Call the rescue centre straight away.
questions.explanation: 她建议首先保持距离观察，因为亲鸟可能还在喂它。

questions.prompt: When should people call the centre?
options: When the bird moves into a tree.
When the bird is feeding itself.
questions.explanation: 罗斯说看得出鸟受伤时应致电救助中心。
